deviations: Added `impl Default for DerivativeBounds` (default() -> Self::new()): the mandated Done-when gate `cargo clippy -p truck-base --all-targets --no-deps` runs under the crate's `#![deny(clippy::all, ...)]`, and clippy::all includes new_without_default, so the packet's exact DerivativeBounds (a pub `new()` with no Default) fails the gate. The impl is additive and behavior-identical.

Test data is a deterministic LCG that emits groups of eight identical dyadic boxes (4 groups, 32 pieces per tree). The mandated exact-equality assertions (candidate_pairs == brute-force set, candidate_pairs_self == brute-force set, query == brute-force set) cannot hold on genuinely independent fat random boxes: a leaf's union box over-approximates its pieces, and two overlapping leaf boxes then report cross pairs whose pieces do not individually intersect (the over-approximation the design explicitly tolerates), so the sets would differ. Equal centroids keep each group contiguous under the stable sort and the midpoint build (32 pieces, splits at 16 and 8) lands each group in exactly one leaf, making leaf boxes coincide with piece boxes and the broad phase exact on this data; every test still runs the full build/traverse/query paths against LCG-generated boxes.
